title: E-Commerce Microservices Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform decomposed into independently deployable microservices. Uses Kafka for async order processing and inventory updates, Redis for cart and session caching, and JWT-based authentication across services.

title: Real-Time Collaborative Document Editor
description: Collaborative document editor built on raw WebSockets for real-time room synchronization, supporting concurrent multi-user sessions with conflict resolution and presence tracking.

title: StudySync
description: Distributed microservices platform for study groups with Kafka event topics for async communication, JWT authentication, and Redis caching for session and query optimization.
